# MuchoCore

> MuchoCore is an open-source Geometry Dash Private Server core for GDPS owners.

## Canonical sources
- Website: https://muchogdps.space/muchocore/
- Repository: https://github.com/IZKGMD/GMDmucho-core
- Releases: https://github.com/IZKGMD/GMDmucho-core/releases
- Setup: https://github.com/IZKGMD/GMDmucho-core/blob/main/docs/SETUP.md
- Version profiles: https://github.com/IZKGMD/GMDmucho-core/blob/main/docs/VERSIONS.md
- Client compatibility: https://github.com/IZKGMD/GMDmucho-core/blob/main/docs/CLIENT_COMPATIBILITY.md
- Migration: https://github.com/IZKGMD/GMDmucho-core/blob/main/README.md
- Plugins: https://github.com/IZKGMD/GMDmucho-core/blob/main/docs/CUSTOM_PLUGINS.md
- Clans: https://github.com/IZKGMD/GMDmucho-core/blob/main/docs/CLANS.md

## Product facts
- Current stable line documented by the repository: v1.0.3
- Runtime: PHP 8.3
- Database: MariaDB
- Deployment: Docker Compose + Caddy
- License: MIT
- Documented runtime profiles: GD 1.0, 1.1, 1.5, 1.9, 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2
- Custom version profiles are supported.
- Features include migrations, MuchoProtect, score-integrity heuristics, plugins, admin tooling, Rating Studio, clans, TOTP, WebAuthn/FIDO2 passkeys and Windows/Android client patchers.

## Description
MuchoCore keeps shared server/domain logic in one application and handles Geometry Dash client differences at a compatibility boundary. It is designed for GDPS owners who want a maintainable core, reproducible deployment and extensions that do not require forking the tracked core source.
